name: condemning-evisceration-prepare-1-paid-skip-banish-no-extra-damage
notes: Condemning Evisceration (r84E55KBLM, EXALTED/WATER ASSASSIN ATTACK, reserve 2, printed power 4): "[Class Bonus] Prepare 1. On Champion Hit: If Condemning Evisceration was prepared, you may banish a card with floating memory from your graveyard. If you do, deal 4 damage to the hit champion." Player 2's champion is Tristan, Shadowdancer (ASSASSIN, UMBRA) patched in with extra lineage cards to unlock the card's element; ATTACK cards cannot be played by the first player on turn 1, so player 1 ends turn 1 and player 2 plays the card with real actions (10002 FSM play, 100 reserve payments / YES-NO answer / attack target). Return to the Archive (Floating Memory) is seeded in player 2's graveyard. Player 2 pays Prepare 1 and attacks, but declines the 'may banish' offer (PASS): no extra damage, the floating-memory card stays in the graveyard.

rulesClauses: On Champion Hit: If Condemning Evisceration was prepared, you may banish a card with floating memory from your graveyard. If you do, deal 4 damage to the hit champion.
